Title: PDF Merger
Description: Merge two or more PDF files into one merged.pdf in your browser, in the order you set with move up/down. Pages keep size and rotation. No upload.
Keywords: merge PDF, combine PDF files, join PDF, PDF merger offline, merge PDF in browser, reorder PDF files, combine documents into one PDF
DropZoneTitle: Drag and drop PDF files here
MergeCanceled: Merge canceled. The file list is unchanged.
MinFilesHint: Select at least 2 PDF files to merge.
ErrorInvalidPdf: {name}: not a valid PDF or the file is damaged.
ErrorEncrypted: {name}: the PDF is password-protected and can't be processed.
Seo_Introduction: Combine two or more PDF files into a single merged.pdf in the browser and set the order with the move up and move down buttons. Your documents stay on your device.
Seo_DetailedDescription:
Pages are appended in list order: all pages of the first file, then all pages of the second, and so on. Each page keeps its size, rotation, crop box and resources such as fonts and images, so it looks exactly like in the source. Add files by dropping them, with **Choose files** or with **Add files**; the same file can be added more than once.

The first file is the base of the result: its bookmarks, form fields and document properties are kept, while those of the other files are not merged — their pages are added as plain pages. Merging runs in a Web Worker with Rust/WebAssembly (lopdf), so the page stays responsive.

A damaged or password-protected file is named in the error message and marked in the list. The whole result is built in memory, so very large sets are limited by the browser's available RAM.
Seo_Examples:
**Cover and report**: `cover.pdf` (1 page) followed by `report.pdf` (2 pages) gives a 3-page `merged.pdf` with the cover first.

**Change the order**: press **Move up** on the last file to move it one place higher; the list order is the page order of the result.

**Locked input**: if one file needs a password to open, merging stops with “locked.pdf: the PDF is password-protected and can't be processed.” and that row is marked **Error**.

**Only one file**: with fewer than two files **Merge PDFs** stays disabled and the hint “Select at least 2 PDF files to merge.” is shown.
Seo_HowToSteps:
### Step 1: Add PDF files
Click **Choose files** or drop PDFs onto **Drag and drop PDF files here**. Use **Add files** to append more later.

### Step 2: Set the order
Use **Move up** and **Move down** on each row; remove a file with **Remove file** or start over with **Clear all**.

### Step 3: Merge
Click **Merge PDFs** (it needs at least two files).

### Step 4: Download
When “PDFs merged successfully!” appears, check the size and click **Download** to save `merged.pdf`.
Seo_Tips:
- Put the file whose bookmarks and form you want to keep first — only the first file's document-level data survives.
- Pages are copied as they are: nothing is re-compressed, so the result is about the sum of the inputs; run it through PDF Compressor if needed.
- Remove the password from protected files before merging.
- Changing the list after a merge hides the old result; merge again to get an updated file.
